title: ERC-20 Exchange-Like Broad Service Surface
description: Inbound-heavy ERC-20 service-like address with broad counterparty reach, many token contracts, and repeated settlement-style interaction patterns.
label: EXCHANGE-LIKE TOKEN SERVICE SURFACE

curation_notes.narrative: This case is useful as an ERC-20 benchmark for exchange-like or service-style token activity: broad but structured counterparty exposure, repeated settlement interactions, and a high-volume token surface that should not be interpreted the same way as a noisy inbound address.
limitations: Derived from ERC-20 transfer rows only
Does not yet include trace-native ERC-20 scoring or swap decoding
Not an authoritative label of illicit activity
